BufferKind.description: Meaning of the samples in a non-colour image.

oneOf.description: Normalised depth, or linear floating-point depth.

heatmap_max.description: Value represented by the top of the heatmap colormap (zero is black).

scale.description: Motion-vector scale, in pixels per signed component unit.

BufferStats.description: Statistics in the buffer's units, rather than perceptual FLIP units.

changed_pixels.description: Mask/id only: number of changed pixels.

exact_match_fraction.description: Mask/id only: fraction of pixels with identical native samples, including alpha.

mean.description: Mean absolute depth, angular or end-point error; changed fraction for discrete buffers.

ChangeClass.description: What kind of change separates the capture from the baseline.

oneOf.description:
A difference whose peak FLIP is at or below `noise_max_flip` and that
no tone shift or offset explains.

One global tone fit (exposure, tint, black level) removes at least
`explained_min` of the error.

Neither a tone fit nor an offset removes `partial_min` of the error and
the error is above noise level.

A tone fit or an offset explains part (at least `partial_min`, below
`explained_min`) of the error; the rest is something else.

A detected sub-pixel or whole-pixel offset removes at least
`explained_min` of the error.

The capture is unusable: all black or all white (the baseline is not),
a flat colour, or it holds NaN or infinite samples.

Diagnostics.description: What the diagnostics engine found for one compared pair.

description.description:
A deterministic, template-based sentence; every cause it names is
backed by the numbers below.

elapsed_ms.description: Wall time of the whole analysis in milliseconds.

nonfinite.description: Non-finite samples of the capture; `None` when there are none.

perf.description: Timing keys present on both sides' sidecars, largest relative change first.

residual.description: Error left after the tone fit; present exactly when `tone` is.

shift.description: Sub-pixel shift; `None` when disabled, identical or negligible.

signed.description: Luminance direction; `None` for an identical pair.

tone.description: Global tone fit; `None` for an identical pair or a negligible error.

baseline_properties.description: Structural checks on the baseline; `None` when there is no decodable baseline.

baseline_sha256.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the baseline file as compared.

bit_identical.description: Whether the decoded pixels are exactly equal; `None` unless compared.

buffer.description: Numerical comparison for non-colour buffers; FLIP metrics stay absent.

capture_sha256.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the capture file as compared.

diagnostics.description:
Why the images differ: cause decomposition, sub-pixel shift, signed
difference, non-finite map, timing pairs and a plain-English
description (see [`crate::diagnostics`]). `None` when diagnostics are
disabled or the pair was not compared as images.

error.description: Human-readable reason; `Some` exactly when status is error.

hdr.description: HDR-FLIP settings when the pair was compared as HDR.

hotspots.description:
Where the FLIP error is concentrated, largest first (see
[`crate::hotspots`]); empty when none exceed the threshold, when the
pair was not compared or when hotspots are disabled.

masked_fraction.description: Fraction of pixels excluded by masks; `None` when no mask applied.

meta_diff.description: Sidecar keys that differ between the sides (ignored keys excluded).

meta_ignored_diff.description:
Sidecar keys that differ but were ignored (timestamps, durations...),
listed so an ignore glob that hides a real change stays visible.

metric_used.description: Metric that decided `status` for this entry (after overrides).

metrics.description: Full FLIP statistics; `None` unless status is pass or fail.

name.description: Path relative to the baseline/capture roots, `/`-separated.

paths.description: Image paths relative to the report directory.

properties.description: Structural checks on the capture; `None` when there is no decodable capture.

regions.description: Per-region results (config `[[region]]`); a failing region fails the entry.

threshold.description: Threshold that decided `status` for this entry (after overrides).

value.description: Value of `metric_used`; `None` unless status is pass or fail.

warnings.description:
Non-fatal observations: an all-black or all-white image, non-finite
samples, a local hotspot that failed an otherwise passing entry.

EntryPaths.description:
Paths (relative to the report directory, `/`-separated) of the images the
report copies or generates. `None` when that image does not exist.

nonfinite_mask.description:
Mask of NaN (magenta), infinite (yellow) and negative (cyan) samples of
an HDR capture, when it has any.

signed_diff.description:
Signed luminance difference (blue darker, orange brighter), when
diagnostics ran on a non-identical pair.

HdrInfo.description: HDR comparison settings actually used for an entry (HDR-FLIP).

auto_range.description: Whether the exposure range was computed from the baseline (true) or given.

tonemapper.description: Tone mapper applied at each exposure (`"aces"`, `"hable"`, `"reinhard"`).

Hotspot.description:
One concentration of FLIP error on the frame, in pixels of the compared
images. Masked pixels never count.

area_frac.description: `area_px` as a fraction of the frame.

area_px.description: Number of pixels above the hotspot threshold that make up the hotspot.

mean_flip.description: Mean FLIP error over the unmasked pixels inside `rect_px`.

position.description:
Coarse 3x3 position of the box centre: `top-left`, `top-center`,
`top-right`, `middle-left`, `center`, `middle-right`, `bottom-left`,
`bottom-center`, `bottom-right`.

rect_frac.description: The same box as fractions of the frame, `[x, y, w, h]`.

rect_px.description: Bounding box `[x, y, w, h]` in pixels.

share_of_total_error.description:
Summed error of the hotspot's pixels over the summed error of every
unmasked pixel of the frame, in `[0, 1]`.

MetaDiff.description: One metadata key whose value differs between the two sides.

baseline.description: Value on the baseline side, or `<absent>`.

capture.description: Value on the capture side, or `<absent>`.

Metric.description: Which statistic of the FLIP error map decides pass/fail.

oneOf.description: Mean FLIP error over all pixels.

Metrics.description:
FLIP error-map statistics. All error values are in `[0, 1]`; a non-finite
value (which a valid run does not produce) is serialized as `null` and read
back as NaN.

NonFiniteCluster.description: A connected group of non-finite samples.

rect_px.description: Bounding box `[x, y, w, h]` in pixels.

NonFiniteMap.description: Where the capture holds NaN, infinite or negative samples (HDR only).

cluster_count.description: Number of 8-connected groups of affected pixels.

clusters.description: Boxes of the first [`MAX_NONFINITE_CLUSTERS`] groups in raster order.

PerfDelta.description: One timing key present on both sides.

delta_pct.description: `delta` as a percentage of `baseline`; `None` when `baseline` is 0.

Properties.description: Structural sanity checks on a single image (catches black frames, blowouts).

inf_count.description: Samples that are infinite (HDR images only).

nan_count.description: Samples that are NaN (HDR images only; always 0 for 8-bit images).

negative_count.description: Finite samples below zero (HDR images only).

RegionResult.description: Result of one named region of interest of an entry.

metrics.description: FLIP statistics over the region; `width`/`height` are the region's.

rect_px.description: Rectangle in pixels after resolving the config fractions: `[x, y, w, h]`.

status.description: `Pass`/`Fail` when the region has a threshold; `None` when informational.

threshold.description: Threshold, when the region has one.

value.description:
Value of `metric_used` over the region (masked pixels excluded); a
fully masked region has no pixels and is `null` (read back as NaN).

Residual.description: FLIP error that remains once the global tone shift is removed.

flip_max.description: Maximum FLIP error of the tone-corrected capture.

flip_mean.description:
Mean FLIP error of the tone-corrected capture (the original mean when
the tone fit is negligible).

hotspots.description: Where that error is concentrated, largest first (at most 3).

SequenceFrame.description: One sorted-index pair, including its actual source names and numbers.

entry.description: Normal comparison entry; images are keyed by its safe synthetic name.

index.description: Zero-based sorted index, independent of either sequence's numbering origin.

ShiftEstimate.description: Sub-pixel shift of the capture against the baseline.

coarse_downsample.description: Factor the first estimate's luminance plane was downsampled by.

confidence.description:
Weighted phase coherence of the cross-spectrum around the fitted
shift, in `[0, 1]`: 1 for a pure translation, near 0 for unrelated
content.

dx.description: Horizontal offset of the capture's content in pixels; positive is right.

dy.description: Vertical offset in pixels; positive is down.

estimate_ms.description: Wall time of the estimate (excluding the compensated FLIP run), in ms.

shift_explained_fraction.description:
Share of the mean FLIP error removed by resampling the capture back by
`(dx, dy)`; `None` unless `detected`.

SignedDiff.description: Which way the luminance moved, over the whole frame.

frac_brighter.description: Fraction of finite pixel pairs brighter by more than half a code value.

frac_darker.description: Fraction of finite pixel pairs darker by more than half a code value.

mean_delta.description:
Mean of `capture - baseline` over finite pixel pairs only. Luminance is
encoded Rec. 709 for LDR; for HDR, scene-linear Rec. 709 luminance is
clamped to `[0, 1]` on each side to bound the display scale. Positive is
brighter. Zero when there are no finite pairs.

scale.description:
Luminance difference mapped to full colour in `signed_diff.png` (the
99.5th percentile of finite absolute differences, at least 0.004).

ToneShift.description: Global tone fit of the capture against the baseline, in linear light.

bias.description: The per-channel bias, in linear light (0 when the fit was gain-only).

exposure_stops.description:
Exposure change in stops: `log2` of the luminance-weighted gain.
Negative is darker.

gain.description: `capture = gain * baseline + bias`, per channel `[r, g, b]`.

model.description:
`affine` when gain and bias were fitted, `gain` when the baseline had
too little tonal range for a bias.

summary.description:
One human-readable line, for example `3.1% darker (-0.05 stops), +0.02
red offset`.

tone_explained_fraction.description:
Share of the mean FLIP error removed by applying the inverse fit to the
capture, in `[0, 1]`; 0 when the fit is negligible.

white_balance.description:
Tint relative to green, for example `warmer (red +2.1%, blue -1.8% vs
green)`, or `neutral`.

error.description: Could not be compared (decode failure, dimension mismatch).

fail.description: Entries whose metric exceeds their threshold.

pass.description: Entries whose metric is at or below their threshold.

WorstFrame.description: Worst paired frame by mean FLIP.

name.description: Synthetic entry name in the per-frame report.

description: Full sequence report on disk; lean outputs omit `frames` and `mean_flip_curve`.

baseline_temporal_mean.description: Mean FLIP between consecutive baseline frames; null with fewer than two or errors.

capture_temporal_mean.description: Mean FLIP between consecutive capture frames; null with fewer than two or errors.

frames.description: Per-frame details on disk; omitted from lean output.

frames_over_threshold.description: Paired entries whose deciding value exceeds their effective threshold.

frames_report_json.description: Absolute path of the normal per-frame comparison report.

index_html.description: Absolute path of the HTML report with the SVG curve.

mean_flip_curve.description: Per-index mean FLIP, null for an unmeasured pair.

report_json.description: Absolute path of this JSON report.

temporal_errors.description: Reasons a temporal metric could not be measured. These fail the run.

temporal_instability.description: Capture temporal mean minus baseline temporal mean; signed, not clamped.

totals.description: Status counts of the indexed pairs.

verdict.description: `pass` or `regression`, with the same rules as compare plus temporal errors.

worst_frame.description: Worst paired frame by mean FLIP, earliest index wins a tie.

title: SequenceReport
